lemmas.name: ms43
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : maxStrength_precond nums), maxStrength_postcond nums (let sublists := nums.sublists.filter (· ≠ []); let products := sublists.map (List.foldl (· * ·) 1); products.foldl max (products.headD 0)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h
  unfold maxStrength_postcond
  obtain ⟨x, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil h
  exact Refine.maxlist_int _ (List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := List.foldl (· * ·) 1 [x]) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[x], List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_sublists.mpr (by simp), by simp⟩, rfl⟩))
